status: frozen development plan; execution recorded separately
motivation: V1 zvec-q001 both failed to deliver an answer despite obtaining the core source evidence. This iteration limits further investigation and measures final-answer completion.
development_selection_disclosure: The budget was selected after reading V1 trajectories: both arms had the main causal evidence by 14/21 tool calls. A common 24-call cap permits that amount of investigation with limited additional checking. This is post-observation development calibration, not a blind or confirmatory performance estimate. No V2 result was available when selecting it.

agent.name: claude-code
agent.repository_guidance: disabled using CLAUDE_CODE_DISABLE_CLAUDE_MDS and CLAUDE_CODE_DISABLE_AUTO_MEMORY; fresh HOME, empty setting sources

retrieval.query_policy: Preserve native main MCP schema and instructions (including its semantic-search guidance); no additional benchmark-specific tool forcing.
retrieval.index_setup: before timed solver; cloned per trial; separately recorded

completion_control.counting: Every unique repository tool_use_id consumes one admission, including tools later failing; all tools share one cap. Duplicate hook events are idempotent. Parallel calls are serialized by a file lock.
completion_control.mechanism: Native Claude PreToolUse command hook; after either budget limit deny new repository tools and request final answer from current evidence. Under budget omit permissionDecision, preserving ordinary permissions.
completion_control.not_guaranteed: No hard separation into a second model invocation. Already running work is not interrupted at 600 seconds. Denial leaves an opportunity to answer but the model may continue requesting denied tools or exhaust total time/turns. Such outcomes remain failures.
completion_control.information_policy: Generic budget/stop/uncertainty text only. No gold, source symbols, issue resolution, content filtering, suggested search terms or task-specific hint.

evaluation.primary: Delivered final answer and source-grounded success under the unchanged q001 rubric; do not grade progress text as final answers.
evaluation.mechanism: Verify hook admission/denial inventory against raw tool IDs; separately report successful retrieval, task failures and infrastructure failures.
evaluation.resources: Count all agent input including cache, output, wall and tool attempts. Mark incomplete session usage unavailable for efficiency comparison. Hook overhead remains in wall time.
evaluation.quality_review: Fresh blinded Codex source audit, labels/metrics hidden; not human or official SWE-QA scoring.
evaluation.retention: Keep V1 failures and all V2 outcomes. Do not replace tasks, gold, budgets or unfavorable runs. Do not pool changed protocols.
evaluation.scope: One development pair can test feasibility and suggest a mechanism, not statistical stability or generalization.
